pages.text: $(d)Floo Tokens$() allow you to use Floo teleportation from anywhere in the world.$(br2)Throw it on the ground and wait several seconds. It will spawn a Temporary Floo Fireplace, which will allow you to teleport to any named Floo Fireplace.
While this will not take any $(l:irregular_implements:items/floo_powder)Floo Powder$(/l), it *will* use up the Token.
